Sensitivity analysis final script

```{r}
#cap for anomalous GPP

sites_daily <- map(sites_daily, function(df) {
  cap <- quantile(df$GPP, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  df %>% mutate(GPP = ifelse(GPP > cap, NA, GPP))
})
```

```{r}
site_slopes <- map_dfr(names(sites_daily), function(site) {
  
  df <- sites_daily[[site]]
  
  binned <- df %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
    mutate(vpd_bin = cut(VPD, breaks = seq(0, 6, by = 0.2))) %>%
    group_by(vpd_bin) %>%
    summarise(
      gpp_max = quantile(GPP, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      vpd_mid = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n >= 3) %>%
    mutate(gpp_norm = gpp_max / max(gpp_max, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  vpd_at_peak <- binned$vpd_mid[which.max(binned$gpp_norm)]
  descending  <- binned %>% filter(vpd_mid >= vpd_at_peak)
  
  if (nrow(descending) < 3) {
    return(tibble(site = site, intercept = NA, slope = NA,
                  vpd_at_peak = NA, n_bins = nrow(descending)))
  }
  
  model <- lm(gpp_norm ~ vpd_mid, data = descending)
  coefs <- coef(model)
  
  tibble(
    site        = site,
    intercept   = coefs[1],
    slope       = coefs[2],
    vpd_at_peak = vpd_at_peak,
    n_bins      = nrow(descending)
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(site = str_remove(site, "_HH_daily"))  # this closing }) was also missing


# Step 2: Build point cloud — raw daily points normalised per site
all_clouds <- map_dfr(names(sites_daily), function(site) {
  
  df <- sites_daily[[site]]
  
  
gpp_max_site <- max(df$GPP, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  df %>%
    drop_na(VPD, GPP) %>%
    mutate(
      gpp_norm = GPP / gpp_max_site,
      site     = str_remove(site, "_HH_daily")
    ) %>%
    select(site, VPD, gpp_norm)
})


# Step 3: Build fitted lines from slopes + intercepts
fitted_lines <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    site    = site,
    vpd_mid = seq(vpd_at_peak, 6, by = 0.1),
    fitted  = intercept + slope * vpd_mid
  )


# Step 4: Plot — cloud + slope line per site
site_names  <- unique(all_clouds$site)
site_groups <- split(site_names, ceiling(seq_along(site_names) / 6))

plots <- map(site_groups, function(sites_subset) {
  
  all_clouds %>%
    filter(site %in% sites_subset) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = VPD, y = gpp_norm)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.2, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_line(data = filter(fitted_lines, site %in% sites_subset),
              aes(x = vpd_mid, y = fitted),
              colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(data = filter(site_slopes, site %in% sites_subset),
               aes(xintercept = vpd_at_peak),
               linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.5)) +
    labs(x = "VPD (kPa)", y = "Normalised GPP") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
})

walk(plots, print)

```

```{r}
# Step 1: fit and assign clusters
slopes_mat_2 <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("site") %>%
  select(slope, vpd_at_peak) %>%
  scale()

hclust_fit_2 <- hclust(dist(slopes_mat_2, method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D2")

# Step 2: derive level order from hclust_fit_2 specifically
cluster_means_2 <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  mutate(cluster_raw = factor(cutree(hclust_fit_2, k = 3))) %>%
  group_by(cluster_raw) %>%
  summarise(mean_slope = mean(slope)) %>%
  arrange(mean_slope)  # most negative = high sensitivity

level_order_2 <- cluster_means_2$cluster_raw

# Step 3: assign and recode in one clean step
site_slopes <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_multi = factor(cutree(hclust_fit_2, k = 3)),
    cluster_multi = fct_recode(cluster_multi,
      "high"   = as.character(level_order_2[1]),
      "medium" = as.character(level_order_2[2]),
      "low"    = as.character(level_order_2[3])
    ),
    cluster_multi = factor(cluster_multi, levels = c("low", "medium", "high"))
  )
```

```{r}
# ── Step 1: scale and fit ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
slopes_mat_2 <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("site") %>%
  select(slope, vpd_at_peak) %>%
  scale()

hclust_fit_2 <- hclust(dist(slopes_mat_2, method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D2")

# ── Step 2: verify cluster number is justified ────────────────────────────────
# Silhouette score — confirm k=3 is optimal
library(cluster)
sil_scores <- map_dbl(2:6, function(k) {
  clusters <- cutree(hclust_fit_2, k = k)
  mean(silhouette(clusters, dist(slopes_mat_2))[, 3])
})
tibble(k = 2:6, silhouette = sil_scores)  # highest score = best k

# ── Step 3: derive label order from mean slope ────────────────────────────────
cluster_means_2 <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  mutate(cluster_raw = factor(cutree(hclust_fit_2, k = 3))) %>%
  group_by(cluster_raw) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_slope     = mean(slope),
    mean_intercept = mean(intercept),
    mean_peak_vpd  = mean(vpd_at_peak),
    n_sites        = n()             # useful to check cluster sizes
  ) %>%
  arrange(mean_slope)                # most negative = high sensitivity

print(cluster_means_2)               # sanity check before labelling
level_order_2 <- cluster_means_2$cluster_raw

# ── Step 4: assign labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
site_slopes <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster_multi = factor(cutree(hclust_fit_2, k = 3)),
    cluster_multi = fct_recode(cluster_multi,
      "High"   = as.character(level_order_2[1]),
      "Medium" = as.character(level_order_2[2]),
      "Low"    = as.character(level_order_2[3])
    ),
    cluster_multi = factor(cluster_multi, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"))
  )

# ── Step 5: verify — check mean slope per labelled cluster ───────────────────
site_slopes %>%
  group_by(cluster_multi) %>%
  summarise(mean_slope = mean(slope), n = n())
```

```{r}
# Define a colourblind-friendly palette that matches your thesis style
pft_cols <- c(
  "WSA" = "#DDCC77",   
  "SAV"  = "#CC6677",    
  "WET" = "#88CCEE",    
  "EBF" = "#999933", 
  "GRA" = "#661100"
)

site_slopes %>%
  count(cluster_multi, PFT) %>%
  group_by(cluster_multi) %>%
  mutate(
    prop          = n / sum(n),
    cluster_multi = factor(cluster_multi, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High"))

  ggplot(aes(x = cluster_multi, y = prop, fill = PFT)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +

  labs(x = "Sensitivity cluster", y = "Proportion of sites", fill = "PFT") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

  "Tropical" = "#DDCC77",    
  "Temperate"  = "#CC6677",    
  "Desert" = "#88CCEE",    
  "Subtropical" = "#999933",
  "Grassland" = "#661100"
)

site_slopes %>%
  count(cluster_multi, koppen) %>%

    prop          = n / sum(n),
```

```{r}
library(patchwork)

# ── Shared colours (already defined in your script) ──────────────────────────
pft_cols <- c(
  "WSA" = "#DDCC77",
  "SAV" = "#CC6677",
  "WET" = "#88CCEE",
  "EBF" = "#999933",
  "GRA" = "#661100"
)

climate_cols <- c(
  "Tropical"    = "#DDCC77",
  "Temperate"   = "#CC6677",
  "Desert"      = "#88CCEE",
  "Subtropical" = "#999933",
  "Grassland"   = "#661100"
)

# ── Shared theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
theme_sens <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text          = element_text(colour = "grey30", size = 9),
      axis.title         = element_text(colour = "grey20", size = 10),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.title         = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", colour = "grey15"),
      plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey45"),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.title       = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin        = unit(c(8, 10, 8, 8), "pt")  # ← fix
    )
}

# ── Helper: compute median order for consistent x-axis sorting ────────────────
order_by_median <- function(df, group_var) {
  df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    mutate(med = median(slope, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(!!group_var := fct_reorder(.data[[group_var]], med))
}

# ── Panel A: slope by PFT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pft_data <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope), !is.na(PFT)) %>%
  order_by_median("PFT")

# Sample size labels for each PFT
pft_n <- pft_data %>%
  count(PFT) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

p_pft <- ggplot(pft_data, aes(x = PFT, y = slope, fill = PFT, colour = PFT)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.25, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.7, pch = 21,
              colour = "white", stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = pft_n,
            aes(x = PFT, y = -Inf, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8, colour = "grey45") +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = pft_cols) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pft_cols) +
  labs(
    title    = "GPP–VPD sensitivity by plant functional type",
    subtitle = "Slope of normalised GPP on VPD above peak (more negative = more sensitive)",
    x        = "Plant functional type",
    y        = "GPP~VPD slope"
  ) +
  theme_sens() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── Panel B: slope by Koppen class ───────────────────────────────────────────
koppen_data <- site_slopes %>%
  filter(!is.na(slope), !is.na(koppen)) %>%
  order_by_median("koppen")

koppen_n <- koppen_data %>%
  count(koppen) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n=", n))

p_koppen <- ggplot(koppen_data, aes(x = koppen, y = slope, fill = koppen, colour = koppen)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.25, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.7, pch = 21,
              colour = "white", stroke = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = koppen_n,
            aes(x = koppen, y = -Inf, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8, colour = "grey45") +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = climate_cols) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = climate_cols) +
  labs(
    title    = "GPP–VPD sensitivity by climate class",
    subtitle = "Ordered by median slope",
    x        = "Köppen climate class",
    y        = "GPP~VPD slope"
  ) +
  theme_sens() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── Combine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_pft / p_koppen +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11))

ggsave("sensitivity_pft_koppen.pdf",  width = 8, height = 9, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave("sensitivity_pft_koppen.png",  width = 8, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# ── Join cluster labels onto clouds and fitted lines ──────────────────────────
cluster_lookup <- site_slopes %>% select(site, cluster_multi)

all_clouds_cl  <- all_clouds  %>% left_join(cluster_lookup, by = "site")
fitted_lines_cl <- fitted_lines %>% left_join(cluster_lookup, by = "site")

# ── Order sites wet to dry within each cluster ────────────────────────────────
site_order <- site_slopes %>%
  arrange(cluster_multi, slope) %>%
  pull(site)

all_clouds_cl   <- all_clouds_cl   %>% mutate(site = factor(site, levels = site_order))
fitted_lines_cl <- fitted_lines_cl %>% mutate(site = factor(site, levels = site_order))
site_slopes_cl  <- site_slopes     %>% mutate(site = factor(site, levels = site_order))

# ── Cluster colours (from earlier) ───────────────────────────────────────────
cluster_colours <- c(
  "Low"    = "#44AA99",
  "Medium" = "#DDCC77",
  "High"   = "#AA4499"
)

# ── Split into pages of 6 sites, preserving cluster order ────────────────────
site_names_ordered <- levels(all_clouds_cl$site)
site_groups        <- split(site_names_ordered,
                            ceiling(seq_along(site_names_ordered) / 6))

plots <- map(site_groups, function(sites_subset) {
  
  cloud_sub   <- all_clouds_cl   %>% filter(site %in% sites_subset)
  fitted_sub  <- fitted_lines_cl %>% filter(site %in% sites_subset)
  slopes_sub  <- site_slopes_cl  %>% filter(site %in% sites_subset)
  
  ggplot() +
    # Raw binned point cloud — coloured by cluster, small and transparent
    geom_point(data = cloud_sub,
               aes(x = VPD, y = gpp_norm, colour = cluster_multi),
               size = 0.4, alpha = 0.15) +
    # Fitted slope line — solid, full opacity
    geom_line(data = fitted_sub,
              aes(x = vpd_mid, y = fitted, colour = cluster_multi),
              linewidth = 0.9) +
    # Peak VPD marker
    geom_vline(data = slopes_sub,
               aes(xintercept = vpd_at_peak, colour = cluster_multi),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) +
    # Slope annotation in corner of each panel
    geom_text(data = slopes_sub,
              aes(label = paste0("β = ", round(slope, 2)),
                  colour = cluster_multi),
              x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4,
              size = 2.8, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cluster_colours, name = "Sensitivity") +
    facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.3)) +
    labs(x = "VPD (kPa)", y = "Normalised GPP") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 9),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey94", linewidth = 0.3)
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1, linewidth = 1)
    ))
})

walk(plots, print)

# ── Optional: save all pages to a single PDF ──────────────────────────────────
pdf("vpd_slopes_by_site.pdf", width = 7, height = 9)
walk(plots, print)
dev.off()
```
